note: The Kentucky Revised Statutes on apps.legislature.ky.gov (read 2026-10-30): KRS 186.531(3) charges $43 for a standard operator's licence and $23 for a personal identification card, each for eight years unless noted ($15 for a licence under 21, up to 4 years; the voluntary travel ID versions are $48 and $28); KRS 186.4101 renews licences and cards every eight years; KRS 186.454 gives an intermediate licence holder an operator's (full) licence from 17. No age is held for the card.

sources.title: KRS 186.531, Fees for licenses, permits, and identification cards
sources.said: the fees imposed for standard operator's licenses, instruction permits, and personal identification cards shall be as follows and, unless otherwise noted, are for an eight (8) year period: ... OL (initial/renewal) $43 $43 $0 $0 ... PIDC (initial/renewal) $23 $20 $3 $0

sources.title: KRS 186.4101, Renewal of license
sources.said: a license to operate a motor vehicle, motorcycle, or moped, or a personal identification card shall be renewed every eight (8) years

sources.title: KRS 186.454, Intermediate license holder application process
sources.said: a person with an intermediate license who is under the age of eighteen (18) years may apply for an operator's license to operate a motor vehicle if the person has: (a) Attained the age of seventeen (17) years;
